Our Classes

Find the perfect class to power your fitness journey

From heart-pumping HIIT sessions to calming yoga flows, our expert-led classes are designed to challenge, motivate, and support you at every stage. Whether you're chasing strength, flexibility, or stress relief, there's a class here with your name on it.

Popular Classes

HIIT

Push your limits with fast-paced, high-intensity intervals designed to torch calories and build endurance fast.

Duration: 45 mins

Class size: Up to 25 people

Ride to the beat in this high-energy cycling class that builds cardio fitness and leg strength.

Duration: 50 mins
